# related note

An undirected associative link between two notes — the semantic sibling of relatedTag, applied to the note graph. Symmetric. Optional: the note graph stays flat-first.

**IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/relatedNote>  
**CURIE:** `gmeow:relatedNote`  

**Type:** `owl:ObjectProperty`, `owl:SymmetricProperty`  

**Defined by:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/slices/notes>
